summary: Fixed three Queue bugs: a trend badge that read 'post by 10-28' or ended in nothing, a scheduled-video card with no time on phones, and section details squeezed into a narrow column on phones.
why: Reading the Queue code (last reviewed 10-17) found the badge cut ISO dates and broke on topics without an expiry; phone screenshots showed the other two. All checks pass (62 smoke tests).

findings.detail: 'post by 10-28', and 'post by ' with nothing after it when a trend has no expiry.

findings.title: Scheduled card time hidden on phones
findings.detail: The publish time sat in a column hidden below 640 px.
